title: Browse indexed object animations
changes: Browse physical object animation banks, sequences, frame durations, object attributes and language selector links; play from a chosen frame with adjustable rate and loop.
Render supported 4-bit and 8-bit objects with manually selected graphics and palettes, retaining empty sequences and zero-count hold metadata.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-obj-animations-synthetic-2vqot9k2 passed 4-bit and 8-bit pixels, flips, palette IDs, missing data, frame timing, controls, focus and standalone layouts in Linux Chrome.

Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-obj-animations-eur-o6npg9q5 matched 18 banks, 355 lists, 1,161 objects, 109 sequences and 382 frames, then checked a real manually paired pixel, playback, selector and hold.
Linux Docker unit rom-data-viewer-obj-animations-docker-4b6h0gza matched Python output byte-for-byte; the validated ignored local page retained its previous data and inspector.
limitations: Graphics and palette pairing is manual; live task timing, affine, mosaic and special object effects are not reconstructed. Native Windows and other preview families remain open.
